cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Pull latest
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git pull origin fix/esm-stable && git reset --hard origin/fix/esm-stable 2>&1 | tail -5")
print("Pulled:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check constructor
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -n '42,55p' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("\nConstructor:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
